questions.stem: Baby of Lata, a newborn baby delivered at 31 weeks of gestation, was admitted to the Neonatal intensive care unit(NICU) for Low birth weight (LBW) care. On the 5th day of life, the child had an apnea episode. On clinical examination, there was no pallor, but auscultation revealed a continuous murmur, and S2 was paradoxically split. An ECG was ordered, which showed left ventricular predominance. What would be the most likely diagnosis?
